questions.question_text: Which Azure CLI command creates a Recovery Services vault?

options.label: A
options.text: az backup vault create --resource-group RG --name MyVault --location eastus

options.label: C
options.text: az storage account create --name mystorage --resource-group RG --location eastus

options.label: D
options.text: az network vnet create --name MyVnet --resource-group RG --location eastus

questions.explanation: The az backup vault create command is documented for provisioning a Recovery Services vault (Microsoft Docs: Create a Recovery Services vault with Azure CLI).

questions.question_text: In the Azure portal, where do you navigate to create a new Backup vault?
questions.explanation: The portal path to add a Backup vault is under Recovery services vaults, as described in the Azure portal backup documentation.

questions.question_text: When configuring a backup policy for Azure VMs, which setting defines the frequency of backups?
questions.explanation: The backup schedule determines how often snapshots are taken, per the Azure Backup policy documentation.

questions.question_text: Which Azure Backup service component is used to protect Azure SQL databases?
questions.explanation: Azure Backup registers SQL databases in a Recovery Services vault, according to the Azure Backup overview.

questions.question_text: To enable Azure Site Recovery for a set of virtual machines, which blade must you select after choosing the source subscription?
questions.explanation: A Site Recovery vault is created to protect resources, as outlined in the Azure Site Recovery documentation.

questions.question_text: During a Site Recovery failover, which option ensures minimal data loss?
questions.explanation: Failover with the latest replication uses the most recent synchronized data, minimizing data loss as described in the Site Recovery failover guide.

questions.question_text: Which Azure Monitor metric indicates that a backup job has failed?
questions.explanation: The BackupFailed metric is used to trigger alerts for failed backup jobs, per Azure Monitor documentation.

questions.question_text: Which PowerShell cmdlet creates a Recovery Services vault?
questions.explanation: The New-AzRecoveryServicesVault cmdlet with required parameters creates the vault, as detailed in the Azure PowerShell documentation.

questions.question_text: In an Azure Backup policy, which setting controls how long recovery points are retained after creation?
questions.explanation: Retention range defines the duration for which recovery points are kept, according to the Azure Backup policy reference.

questions.question_text: Which Azure dashboard widget provides a summary of backup health across all vaults?
questions.explanation: The Backup health widget aggregates health status of backup jobs across vaults, as described in the Azure portal monitoring documentation.
